programs.title: Krishna Cottage
programs.desc: The movie revolves around a group of college students who visit a haunted house called "Krishna Cottage." As they unravel the mystery behind the house, they uncover dark secrets and a vengeful spirit that haunts them

programs.title: Bollywood Diaries
programs.desc: Rohit, Vishnu, and Imli are aspiring actors who come from different backgrounds and dream to make it big in Bollywood. However, each of them must diligently brave both internal and professional struggles to even survive in the coveted industry.

programs.title: Besharam
programs.desc: A car thief falls in love with a woman whose car he has stolen.

programs.title: Bluffmaster
programs.desc: Ace con artist Roy leads a double life, convincing his girlfriend Simmi he is an ordinary, honest guy. However, when she discovers the truth, he is powerless to save their relationship. After collapsing on the street, Roy discovers he has a brain tumour and hasn't long to live. Before it is too late, his partner and disciple Dittu persuades Roy to take part in one last master plan.
